pretreatments.description: Thermal-pretreatment conducted at 30 min at 50 °C using a water bath (CW-10G, Jeio Tech), and at 30 min at 80 °C using a water bath (CW-10G, Jeio Tech), and at 30 min at 120 °C using an autoclave (HAC-045, LK LabKorea).
Ultrasonic-pretreatment conducted for 30, 90, and 180 seconds on an ultrasonicator (VCX-130, Vibra-Cell) of 130 W.
Alkali-pretreatment adjusted to pH 9, 11, and 13 by using 5 N NaOH.
